# Djgent 0.4.0

Released: 2026-04-29

Djgent 0.4.0 adds settings-backed memory defaults, DRF view-backed tools, and
fixes chat URL generation for mounted chat routes.

## Highlights

- Added global memory defaults through `DJGENT["MEMORY_ENABLED"]` and
  `DJGENT["MEMORY_BACKEND"]` for `Agent.create()`.
- Added DRF view-backed tools with documentation and demo support, including
  the featured books API example.
- Fixed built-in chat detail URLs so `/chat/` mounts no longer produce repeated
  `chat/` path segments.
- Updated package dependencies to include OpenAI LangChain and Django REST
  Framework requirements.
- Added tests and docs for memory settings defaults, memory override behavior,
  DRF view tools, and mounted chat URL generation.

## Maintenance

- Cleaned formatting in agent, chat, checks, demo, migration, and test modules.
- Added a narrow Ruff migration line-length ignore for generated migration files.

## Verification

- `uv run pytest` -> 71 passed, 1 skipped
- `uv run ruff check .` -> all checks passed
- `uv build` -> built `dist/djgent-0.4.0.tar.gz` and
  `dist/djgent-0.4.0-py3-none-any.whl`

## Install

```bash
pip install djgent==0.4.0
```
